final_answer:
ALS vs control in the cervical spinal cord shows a broad differential-expression signature dominated by glial/myeloid activation.

Top up-regulated genes include GPNMB, CHIT1, PLA2G7, LYZ, CTSS, DNASE2B, MS4A7, APOC1, HGF, and CCL18. Top down-regulated genes include SMURF1, HIP1, THOC5, DLC1, NDE1, GRB10, ABTB2, SH3BP4, ARHGEF2, and MAN2A2.

Using DESeq2 on the aligned raw counts, 13,205 genes were significant at padj < 0.05 (5,741 up and 7,464 down).

The result suggests strong neuroinflammatory / microglial-lysosomal activation in ALS cervical spinal cord, but bulk tissue cannot distinguish cell-intrinsic regulation from shifts in cellular composition.
